name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: In Razor Hill, Dwukk can teach you a camp craft suited to your blacksmithing skill. A Sharpening Wheel gives nearby fighters a way to hone their weapons.

sections.title: A camp craft
sections.body:
Dwukk teaches you to craft a Sharpening Wheel once you show skill in blacksmithing. Set it up at a wilderness camp, where nearby fighters and rogues can hone their weapons.

You need a campfire to start your camp. Cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Sharpening Wheel?
faq.answer: Dwukk in Razor Hill teaches you to craft a Sharpening Wheel once you show skill in blacksmithing.

faq.q: What does the Sharpening Wheel do?
faq.answer: Nearby fighters and rogues can use a Sharpening Wheel at your camp to hone their weapons.

faq.q: Where can I try out my camp?
faq.answer: Try out your camp in the wilderness. Camps should not be set up in the center of town.
Yes. You need a campfire to start your camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you can learn from Dwukk to craft a Sharpening Wheel for a wilderness camp.
As a rogue, you can hone your weapons at a nearby Sharpening Wheel set up at camp.
